lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg2Ti12O24 (MgTi6O12) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/c (No. 15), with 38 atoms per unit cell distributed over six independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies Mg centers as octahedral, coordinated by six O neighbors, while Ti centers adopt octahedral and trigonal-bipyramidal O coordination, with O centers surrounded by three or four Ti and Mg neighbors. Corner-sharing between Mg and Ti octahedra is observed, along with edge- and corner-sharing between Ti octahedra and Ti trigonal-bipyramidal polyhedra, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network.
